newsitem.title: UK: EUROPE RAW COTTON AWAITS DIRECTION.
newsitem.headline: EUROPE RAW COTTON AWAITS DIRECTION.

text.p: European mill demand stayed thin with most spinners disposed to await further pointers to fundamentals of supply and demand before anticipating additional needs.

A USDA August estimate of the US new crop at 17.8 million bales gave no new impetus. Occasional inquiry was evident in Germany, France and Belgium and a few price testing inquiries were noted in Portugal. Eastern European markets were dull and long staple varieties neglected.
